title: Flova AI uses CDANCE 2.0 to create full videos with real human #AIvideo #VideoEditing #FlovaAI
description:
Flova AI is a creative video production platform that leverages CDANCE 2.0, a leading video generation model, to create full-length videos using real human references—something typically unsupported by most platforms. It allows users to upload custom characters and reference images to generate not only short clips but also larger projects such as commercials and music videos. The core advantage of Flova AI lies in its end-to-end workflow, which includes generating a complete creative brief, storyboard, and all necessary assets such as images, videos, background music, and narration. Users can start from scratch or use built-in workflows tailored for CDANCE 2.0, giving them control to review, approve, edit, and regenerate visuals throughout the process. This approach streamlines video creation, making it accessible while maintaining high-quality output suitable for professional use. By combining advanced AI video modeling with a flexible, interactive production environment, Flova AI delivers significant value for creators and businesses looking to produce engaging multimedia content efficiently. It bridges the gap between AI-generated clips and fully polished videos ready for final editing and export. #FlovaAI #CDANCE2 #AIVideoCreation
